title: Events Engagement and Civic Support Officer
description:
Events Engagement and Civic Support Officer

Location: Barking Town Hall, Barking & Dagenham
Working Pattern: 3 days per week in the office
Rate: £21.66 PAYE £28.24 Umbrella
Contract: Up to 6 months
Start Date: ASAP
DBS: Basic Check Required

About the Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Events Engagement and Civic Support Officer to join a busy local authority events team. This varied role combines event coordination, administration, stakeholder engagement, diary management, communications, and financial administration, supporting a wide range of community, civic and mayoral events across the borough.

You'll work closely with internal departments, event organisers, community groups and external partners to ensure events are planned, coordinated and delivered successfully. You'll also play an important role in supporting civic functions, mayoral activities and fundraising events.

Key Responsibilities
- Process and coordinate event applications for community and commercial events.
- Provide administrative support to the Safety Advisory Group, including arranging meetings, preparing agendas, and taking minutes.
- Liaise with event organisers, council departments, emergency services, and other key stakeholders.
- Prepare reports, presentations, information packs, and communications materials.
- Support management of the Mayor's diary, invitations, and correspondence.
- Organise civic events, including Mayor Making ceremonies, remembrance events, and community celebrations.
- Coordinate fundraising events and community engagement activities.
- Manage financial administration, including invoices, purchase orders, and record keeping.
- Maintain databases, inboxes, and social media updates.

About You

We're looking for an organised and proactive individual who can manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

You will have:

Experience organising and supporting events from planning through to delivery.

Strong administrative and IT skills, including spreadsheets, presentations, meeting documentation, and correspondence.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.

The ability to prioritise workloads, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.

The confidence to work independently as well as part of a team.

Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach.

Additional Information
- 3 office days per week.
- Some evening and weekend work will be required to support events and civic functions.
- Time Off In Lieu (TOIL) will be provided for approved out-of-hours working.
- No formal qualifications are required.

title: Account Manager (Affiliate Marketing)
description:
Purpose of position

Our Key Account Management team is looking for an Account Manager to come and work on the affiliate programmes for advertisers across a various range of sectors. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your analytical and strategic skills. You will act as a point of contact for clients on the Awin network, advising on best practice and offering recommendations on optimising affiliate programmes. As an active member of the team, you will implement strategies for improving their account, offering guidance and training throughout this process. The role involves devising innovative and new account management ideas to help grow affiliate revenues for your client, and across the Account Management team. AMT sits in Managed Services, which means we take a proactive approach with our clients. You are the expert!

You will have exposure to an extensive range of brands, receive in-depth training across multiple subjects, and have the opportunity to collaborate on wider projects. The role will involve bringing innovation and strategy to your clients and maintaining engagement with clients and publishers alike in order to deliver sophisticated results. As a result, this role is perfect for anyone looking to push forward their career within a fast-paced and dynamic industry.

Key Tasks
- Deliver excellent service and relationship management to clients and agencies across accounts in your remit
- Be the internal owner of all assigned accounts and be fully informed and able to provide information when required, to include metrics, objectives and status
- Generating reports and providing analysis on performance, and ensuring commentary is accurate and insightful with a view at improving activity
- Taking ownership of and streamlining processes
- Regular client calls and the ability to be reactive and supportive of client goals
- Initiate and implement ideas to grow affiliate activities in line with the needs of clients and assist clients in the creation of quarterly and yearly strategies
- Producing competitor benchmarks for your clients, while proactively advising on industry trends and identifying opportunities for merchants
- Take 100% ownership of assigned accounts delivery and service levels and pro-actively providing insight to Team Leader
- Building relevant and comprehensive client roadmaps to help achieve success
- Optimising existing publisher relationships and recruiting new and exciting publisher opportunities for advertisers
- Presenting confidently, both internally and externally, on a range of topics.
- Ensuring that you and your clients are up to date with all technology and tracking optimisations, and that all campaigns make the best use of these

Skills & Expertise
- Enthusiastic, committed, and passionate about digital
- 1+ years' account management experience in a relevant digital marketing role
- Numerate with a good level of knowledge of MS Office packages
- Ability to see the bigger picture and identify areas of opportunity and risk
- Professional and with a proven track record of successful client and team relationship building, including strong networking skills
- Seeks ownership and readily accepts accountability
- Strong time management and organizational skills to maintain own work flow and meet deadlines
- Confident and excellent communicator with a keen attention to detail

Our Offer
- Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
- Flexi-Office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid working model, designed to foster collaboration, trust, and autonomy.
- Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace at home.
- Pension: We make regular contributions to support your retirement savings.
- Private Medical Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for a range of health, vision and dental treatments.
- Electric Vehicle & Cycle to Work Schemes: Save on commuting costs through tax-efficient schemes for electric vehicle leasing and bike purchase.
- Workplace Nursery Benefit: Save on childcare costs through a salary sacrifice scheme with tax and National Insurance savings. In addition, you'll benefit from our global offering, including health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and development via Awin Academy, and peer-to-peer recognition programmes.

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we've had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world's leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.

title: Account Manager - Marketing Agency
description:
ACCOUNT MANAGER - MARKETING AGENCY
CENTRAL LONDON - HYBRID
UP TO £45,000 + CAREER DEVELOPMENT

THE OPPORTUNITY:
Enjoy building client relationships and helping clients get more from their websites and marketing? Get Recruited is partnering with an established creative digital agency to recruit a SEO Account Manager with the curiosity to understand a client's goals and the initiative to turn ideas into improvements.
You'll join a collaborative team, take ownership of established accounts and have a progression plan with opportunities to develop a specialism and work with more ambitious clients. This opportunity would suit an SEO Account Manager, Agency Account Manager or Client Success Manager with experience in a marketing, creative or digital agency.

THE SEO ACCOUNT MANAGER ROLE:
- Own relationships with a portfolio of retained clients following website launch, building trust and understanding their wider marketing priorities.
- Act as a proactive adviser, recommending how websites, SEO, email marketing, branding and other agency services can support each client's objectives.
- Bring the relationship-building approach of an Agency Account Manager to regular client calls, reviews and meetings, presenting ideas clearly and agreeing practical next steps.
- Apply your Client Success Manager skills to keeping clients informed, managing expectations and following enquiries through to resolution.
- Turn client requests into clear briefs for designers and developers, coordinating smaller projects and website enhancements through to completion.
- Manage competing requests across multiple accounts, assessing urgency, clarifying requirements and prioritising work with the delivery team.
- Take an Agency Account Manager approach to developing existing accounts: identify relevant additional services, explain their value and present recommendations to clients.
- Combine proactive Client Success Manager support with hands-on website care, carrying out monthly WordPress and plugin updates and preparing website performance reports.
- Review website results, identify opportunities for improvement and explain recommendations in language clients can understand.
- Build your portfolio through a phased handover, giving you time to understand each client and their priorities.

THE PERSON:
- Experience working within a marketing, creative or digital agency is essential, including responsibility for multiple client relationships.
- You may currently be a SEO Account Manager, Agency Account Manager or Client Success Manager with exposure to websites and digital marketing.
- A clear interest in creativity, technology and the work your clients do, with examples of taking initiative and following through.
- Confident written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail and the ability to ask useful questions, interpret a brief and explain technical information clearly.
- An organised, collaborative approach, with sound judgement when priorities change.
- An understanding of how websites support wider marketing objectives.
- Alongside your agency background, practical experience in at least one further area: website technology and CMS platforms; SEO; analytics and reporting; digital campaigns; or independent school admissions or marketing.
- Education sector experience is particularly welcome, especially working with independent schools, but is not essential.

THE BENEFITS:
- £35,000-£45,000 depending on experience.
- Hybrid working.
- An individual progression plan, with scope to develop expertise and take on larger, more ambitious accounts.
- Autonomy as you build your knowledge, supported by colleagues across design, development and project management.
- Quarterly team socials and annual team away days.
- Employer pension contribution of up to 4% and a cycle-to-work scheme.

title: Amazon Marketplace and PPC Executive
description:
The Opportunity

We are recruiting an Amazon Marketplace and PPC Executive to take hands-on commercial ownership of our Amazon channel and drive profitable sales growth. This is not a PPC-only position; the successful candidate will be responsible for Amazon sales performance, advertising, listings, organic ranking, conversion, pricing, promotions, stock availability and product launches.

What Will You Bring

Strong practical Amazon Marketplace and Seller Central experience, proven PPC capability and a track record of growing Amazon sales. You will be commercially minded, confident with performance data and proactive in turning insight into action. Experience with Excel or Google Sheets and AI-assisted content and analysis is important.

Full Job Description Original Wording Retained

Role Purpose

Own the Amazon channel end-to-end and deliver profitable sales growth. This is not a PPC-only role; the successful candidate will be accountable for Amazon sales, listings, organic ranking, conversion, pricing, promotions, PPC, stock availability and product launches. The role is suited to someone who is highly driven by sales numbers, acts quickly on performance data and takes ownership of the Amazon result.

Key Responsibilities

Sales and Commercial Performance:
- Own weekly, monthly and annual Amazon sales targets and growth plans.
- Monitor sales, orders, units, average selling price, conversion and contribution performance.
- Identify winning SKUs to scale and underperforming SKUs requiring action.
- Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, rankings and category activity.
- Build and manage the Amazon trading calendar, including Prime events, Black Friday, Christmas and other key trading periods.
- Recommend pricing, coupons, promotions and deal activity within the approved commercial framework.

Amazon PPC:
- Own Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and relevant display / remarketing campaigns.
- Manage keywords, search terms, targeting, bids, budgets and campaign testing.
- Optimise ACOS, TACOS, ROAS and PPC sales while supporting total Amazon growth.
- Use PPC data to identify organic keyword opportunities and improve listings.
- Align ad spend with stock availability, launches and promotional priorities.

Listings, SEO and Conversion:
- Optimise titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, images, videos and A+ content where relevant.
- Improve organic visibility, keyword ranking and conversion rate.
- Monitor reviews, ratings, Buy Box and account-health issues.
- Work with Product / PIM and Creative teams to ensure listings are complete, accurate and commercially strong.

Stock, Forecasting and Product Launches:
- Monitor Amazon stock availability and identify out-of-stock or excess-stock risks early.
- Work with Product / Buying on demand trends, launch quantities and promotional stock requirements.
- Work with Customer Fulfilment on Linnworks, FBA / 3 PL and stock-discrepancy issues.
- Own Amazon launch execution for new products, including listing readiness, keyword strategy, PPC setup, pricing and early performance optimisation.

Research, Reporting and Action:
- Conduct keyword, search-demand, competitor and category research.
- Provide concise weekly reporting covering sales, conversion, traffic, PPC, ranking, stock risks and actions.
- Every review should answer: What happened Why did it happen What are we doing next

AI-Assisted Creative and Productivity:
- Use approved AI tools to create or adapt Amazon listing and campaign assets, including draft lifestyle concepts, creative variations and promotional visuals.
- Use AI to support copy ideation, keyword research, competitor analysis and performance insight generation.
- Create multiple creative versions for testing while maintaining product accuracy and brand consistency.
- Work with the Content and Creative Marketing Executive to ensure final assets meet channel and brand requirements.

Key Performance Indicators:
- Amazon sales £ and sales growth %
- Orders / units and sales vs target
- Contribution / profitable growth
- Conversion rate and traffic
- Organic keyword ranking
- PPC sales, ACOS, TACOS and ROAS
- In-stock rate and stock-out risk
- Listing completeness and launch readiness
- Promotion and new-product launch performance

Candidate Profile:
- Strong hands-on Amazon Marketplace and Seller Central experience.
- Proven Amazon PPC experience with evidence of commercial results.
- Demonstrated ability to grow Amazon sales, not just optimise advertising metrics.
- Strong understanding of ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, conversion and keyword / search-term performance.
- Strong Excel / Google Sheets analytical skills.
- Confident using AI tools for creative asset production, copy ideation, research and analysis.
- Highly proactive, commercially minded and comfortable taking ownership of targets.
- Able to balance sales growth, stock availability and profitability.
- Strong cross-functional communication and problem-solving skills.

Success in the Role

I own the Amazon number.

The successful person understands what is driving the Amazon result, what is holding it back, and what actions are required to grow it profitably.

title: Assistant Marketing Manager
description:
An exciting opportunity has opened up for an Assistant Marketing Manager to join a leading global consumer brand and play a key role in its continued growth. With a strong focus on social media, influencer marketing and digital campaigns, this is a hands-on position offering plenty of scope to shape brand activity, lead a small team and contribute to wider marketing initiatives.

Hayes, West London Hybrid (4 Days in Office)
£40,000 - £45,000 DOE

Applicants must have people management experience

About the Company

Our client is a market-leading global manufacturer of premium sleep products, known for combining innovative technology with exceptional comfort. Their products reach consumers and major retail partners across the UK, making this a great opportunity to join an established brand with a strong market presence.

The Role

Reporting to the Marketing & DTC Director, you'll take the lead on social media and influencer marketing, bringing fresh ideas to campaigns that build brand awareness, engage audiences and drive growth. Alongside this, you'll support activity across digital, ecommerce, retail and brand marketing, working closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies to deliver effective, joined-up campaigns.

You'll also line manage and develop the Marketing Executive team, helping to drive performance across the wider marketing function.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and lead the social media strategy across all platforms, growing engagement and strengthening the brand's online presence.
- Take ownership of influencer marketing, from sourcing partnerships and briefing creators to delivering campaigns and analysing results.
- Manage paid social activity and collaborate with media agencies on PPC, SEO, display and wider digital campaigns.
- Line manage, support and develop the Marketing Executive team.
- Work alongside the Marketing & DTC Director to plan and deliver integrated marketing campaigns.
- Track campaign performance using Google Analytics and other reporting tools, identifying opportunities to improve results.
- Support ecommerce activity, keeping website content and digital marketing assets accurate, relevant and up to date.
- Work with the sales team to deliver marketing support for retail partners.
- Plan and coordinate consumer and trade events, exhibitions and experiential activity.
- Oversee social media community management, ensuring consistent and engaging interactions with audiences.

About You
- Extensive experience in social media management and influencer marketing, with a strong understanding of what drives engagement and brand growth.
- Previous people management experience, with the ability to motivate, lead and develop a small team.
- A solid understanding of digital marketing, including paid social, PPC, SEO and display advertising.
- Experience briefing and managing external marketing, PR and media agencies.
- Confident using Google Analytics and campaign reporting tools to measure performance and inform decisions.
- Strong communication, organisation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects at once.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-known consumer brand in a broad marketing role where you'll take ownership of social media and influencer activity while supporting the wider marketing strategy and leading a small team.

Handle actively welcomes applicants from under-represented backgrounds - we pride ourselves on attracting the best talent for every opportunity through a commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion.

title: B2B Events & Marketing Manager
description:
Are you a commercially minded events and marketing professional who knows how to turn campaigns into revenue-generating opportunities?

I'm partnering with an established, growing B2 B organisation to find an Events & Marketing Manager who can combine strategic campaign management, creative marketing and commercial thinking to drive performance across a portfolio of products.

Taking ownership of event and marketing campaigns across multiple product brands, you'll work closely with senior stakeholders, Sales and Marketing teams to ensure campaigns engage the right audiences, generate quality leads and contribute to revenue growth.

You'll combine big-picture planning with hands-on campaign oversight, ensuring activity is commercially focused, well executed and continually optimised.

Day to Day

Commercial Strategy & Revenue Growth
- Drive the commercial performance of digital and in-person event campaigns, with a focus on registrations, attendance, sponsorship, pipeline and revenue.
- Work with senior stakeholders and Sales teams to develop campaign plans that support revenue targets and maximise commercial opportunities.
- Identify opportunities for cross-selling, partnership development and revenue growth across multiple product lines.
- Use CRM data and campaign insights to improve targeting, strengthen sales opportunities and maximise ROI.
- Track performance against KPIs, produce meaningful commercial reports and ensure accurate attribution of leads and deals.

B2 B Marketing & Campaign Management
- Oversee integrated campaign schedules across multiple products, ensuring consistent delivery, quality and commercial alignment.
- Collaborate with Marketing teams on email, social media, paid promotion, partner marketing and audience engagement.
- Ensure messaging is tailored to the right B2 B audiences, with compelling propositions that drive registrations, engagement and conversion.
- Review and approve invitations, prospect outreach and nurture campaigns.
- Use campaign data, dashboards and reporting to identify opportunities for optimisation and continuous improvement.

Events & Partnership Development
- Oversee the successful delivery of a varied portfolio of digital and face-to-face events.
- Support the development of event programmes, speaker content, sponsorship activity and partner relationships.
- Identify new opportunities to grow the event calendar through strategic partnerships and commercial collaboration.
- Ensure every event delivers a consistent, high-quality experience while meeting its commercial objectives.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement
- Coach and develop Executives and Leads, building their campaign management, commercial awareness and problem-solving capabilities.
- Work closely with senior leaders to monitor performance, support development and drive accountability.
- Champion innovation, share best practice and continually look for smarter ways to improve campaign effectiveness.

YOU?
- Experience in B2 B events, integrated marketing campaigns or campaign management, with responsibility for multiple products, campaigns or event programmes.
- A strong understanding of commercial KPIs, including revenue generation, lead generation, pipeline development, registrations and conversion.
- Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing and senior stakeholders to deliver measurable results.
- Confidence using CRM and marketing platforms, ideally Salesforce and ON24 or similar systems.
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data, report on performance and identify opportunities for growth.
- Excellent communication, organisation and stakeholder management skills.
- The ability to lead, coach and motivate others while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
- A proactive, commercially driven mindset, with a genuine appetite for innovation and continuous improvement.

If you're an ambitious B2 B marketing and events professional who combines excellent campaign delivery with a strong commercial mindset, this could be the next step in your career.

title: B2B Marketing Lead
description:
The B2 B Marketing Lead role is a new role which will lead on marketing for a new product offering within the business. Role based in London with hybrid working.

Client Details

Our client are a leading and renowned global payments platform who are launching a new B2 B service and product offering - this role will be responsible for marketing the new product offering across European territories. The role is based in London and will be on an initial day rate contract.

Description

The responsibilities of the B2 B Marketing Lead:
- Own and deliver the integrated UK&I B2 B marketing strategy and 12-month activation plan across research, content, campaigns, sales enablement and client engagement.
- Lead associated market research programmes, from brief and audience definition through to development of actionable insights and external activation.
- Develop a portfolio of issuer-, and acquirer -ready content and sales-enablement assets, including thought leadership, digital content and compelling UK&I case studies.
- Plan and execute targeted marketing activity to build awareness, create demand and support increased commercial-card acceptance among priority audiences.
- Develop and deliver client engagement programmes, including webinars, roundtables and events, connecting thought leadership and research to commercial conversations.
- Partner with Sales, Product and European/Global Marketing teams to ensure UK&I activity is commercially relevant, scalable and complementary to existing programmes.
- Own programme measurement, budget and agency management, demonstrating marketing impact through agreed engagement, activation and commercial KPIs.
- Drive stakeholder engagement across marketing, sales and product teams, but also with client marketing contacts where relevant

Profile

The successful candidate for the B2 B Marketing Lead role:
- Will have B2 B Marketing experience within a financial services/FinTech/Payments background
- Will be familiar with working within a matrixed environment and how to navigate this
- Strategic and hands on experience across all B2 B channels
- The role will cover brand awareness and lead generation programmes.

Job Offer

This role will be contract on an initial day rate.

title: Brand and Marketing Manager
description:
The Studio

A founder-led womenswear brand built on instinct, sensuality and a singular point of view. Our client designs for women who dress for themselves. Their world is sun-soaked, cinematic and unapologetic, and their content is how that world comes to life. This studio is a lean, fast-moving team with a global audience and ambitious plans.

The opportunity

This role turns the founders' creative direction into a plan and makes sure it happens, on time and to the right standard. The creative directors set the vision for each season. You bring it to life across every channel, run the marketing and comms calendar, and lead the brand and content team day to day from the London studio.

You'll need a strong eye for what aligns with the brand, but this is a delivery and leadership role rather than a creative direction one. You'll be the person who keeps everything moving while the founders focus on the creative.

What you'll own
- The marketing and comms calendar for every drop, built against the critical path.
- Launches across homepage, email, social, PR and paid, so every drop lands consistently.
- Day-to-day leadership of the brand and content team, including production, digital design and social.
- Clear reporting to the founders on what's working and what's next.

Planning and delivery
- Turn the founders' seasonal direction into a clear plan for each drop: what goes out, where, when, and who owns it.
- Own the marketing and comms calendar, aligned with Product and the critical path.
- Brief the team, freelancers and agencies, and track every piece of work from brief to live.
- Run regular check-ins so everyone, including founders working remotely, knows where things stand.

Channels
- Own homepage and email planning: what gets pushed, when, and why.
- Coordinate social, PR, paid and wholesale activity around each launch.
- Work with Digital, Production, Design and Ecommerce so product is merchandised at the right time.

Social and influencer strategy
- Work with the Social Lead to drive the social strategy forward, with clear goals for each channel and each drop.
- Shape the influencer and creator strategy: who we work with and why, the mix of gifted and paid, budgets, and how we measure results.
- Hold the team to those goals and use the results to decide what they do next.

Production
- Support campaign and content shoots: schedules, budgets, call sheets and asset delivery.
- Make sure every shoot is captured for all channels and that assets are used to their full potential.

Team leadership
- Line-manage and performance-manage the brand, content and social team, including the Social Lead.
- Run regular one-to-ones and reviews, set clear objectives, and follow through when performance needs to improve.
- Set a clear standard for every role, so each person knows what good looks like, what doesn't meet the bar, and how to get there.
- Support each person's development and progression.
- Manage freelancer and contractor relationships as an extension of the team.
- Be the point of accountability to the founders for the team's output.

Reporting and budget
- Track performance across channels and report monthly to the founders: what worked, what didn't, and what they'll do next.
- Manage the brand and content budget.

The Ideal Candidate
- You have 4+ years in marketing, brand, or content at a fashion or lifestyle brand, ideally premium or founder-led.
- You're highly organised and have owned a marketing calendar or critical path with many moving parts.
- You've managed people and enjoy helping a team do its best work.
- You have a strong eye. You instinctively know what feels on brand, even though you won't be setting the creative direction.
- You're comfortable with numbers and use them to make decisions.
- You communicate clearly and are confident working with founders who aren't always in the studio.
- You're at home with project tools (we use Monday and Slack), design tools like Figma or Canva, and AI.

This is a great opportunity to join a small, dynamic creative team and play a key role in shaping the social presence of an exciting and growing fashion brand.

This is a hybrid role, with 3 days on-site and 2 days remote.

title: Brand Manager
description:
Our client, a leading pharmaceutical and nutritional healthcare organisation, is seeking a Brand Manager to join its marketing team in North West London on a 12-month maternity cover contract. This is an exciting opportunity to support the growth of well-known consumer health and supplement brands through strategic brand management, brand design, digital marketing and integrated campaign activity.
The role is based in NW2 7 HF and follows a hybrid working model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. Core working hours are 9:30am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday, totalling 40 hours per week. The anticipated start date is January or February 2027.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing a portfolio of consumer healthcare and nutritional brands
- Supporting ATL and BTL marketing activity across radio, print, outdoor advertising, digital marketing, sampling and other promotional channels

Reports to: Communications Manager

Hours: Full-time, 35 hours per week

Salary: £36,500

Contract: Permanent

Location: Hybrid 2 days a week in Blackfriars, London, with monthly travel

About the role

It s an exciting time to join the Third Age Trust as we develop our marketing and communications to promote u 3a, attract new members and support u 3as across the UK.

Reporting to the Communications Manager, you ll work with the existing Communications Officer and Digital Marketing Manager to develop engaging content and campaigns that raise awareness of u 3a and inspire people to join. We re looking for a creative communicator who can find stories, develop ideas from concept to publication and choose the right channels for different audiences.

You ll bring hands-on experience of email, social media, writing, imagery and short-form video, plus experience working with a PR agency. You ll build relationships with members and volunteers, use feedback and results to improve communications, and deliver accurate, engaging work within agreed priorities.

Key responsibilities
- Develop written, visual and digital content for the u 3a website, email, newsletters, social media, reports, blogs, publications and PR.
- Turn research, insight, data, policy and member activity into accessible, accurate communications for members, prospective members, media and other audiences.
- Identify stories, case studies, evidence and content angles; support the Communications Manager and PR agency with research-led and member stories.
- Plan and deliver communications activity around research, insight, impact and policy outputs.
- Write and deliver the monthly u 3a Friends newsletter and other Trust newsletters.
- Contribute to organic social media and work with Digital Marketing to improve content, messaging and calls to action using performance insights.
- Ensure publications, reports and publicity materials are clear, accessible and consistent with u 3a s brand.
- Use CMS, email/e-CRM, social platforms and Adobe Creative Suite/Canva or similar tools to produce content.
- Build strong relationships with staff, volunteers, members, trustees, suppliers and external partners; support other departmental projects as needed.

Person specification

Essential
- Experience in communications, content, marketing or research communications, creating material for different audiences across web, newsletters, email, social media, reports, publications or PR.
- Ability to identify strong stories and work with colleagues and stakeholders to turn them into content.
- Strong editorial judgement, writing, editing and proofreading, with excellent attention to detail.
- Able to translate complex research, insight, data and evidence into clear, engaging, accurate and accessible communications.
- Skilled in digital content creation, prioritising multiple projects and deadlines, and building constructive working relationships.
- Understanding of audience-focused communication, brand consistency, accessibility, inclusion and the use of research and evidence in PR and engagement.
- Familiarity with CMS, email and social media tools and Adobe Creative Suite or similar. A marketing or communications qualification is advantageous; equivalent experience is accepted.
- Creative, curious, collaborative and proactive; sound judgement, care with evidence, flexibility and a commitment to presenting u 3a as active, relevant and welcoming.

Desirable
- Experience in a charity, membership organisation, public sector or education setting.
- Experience creating infographics, animations, images or short-form video, including editing.
- Experience using Mailchimp or similar email platforms, Joomla or another CMS, and channel performance data to improve content.
- Knowledge of lifelong learning, volunteering, community participation, positive ageing and the age agenda.

First six months
- Learn the Trust s content tools and build relationships across Marketing, Communications, Digital Marketing, Policy and Research.
- Connect research and policy with communications, translating insight into compelling, accurate content.
- Use performance data to improve messages and calls to action, newsletters, web, social, PR and publications.
- Make better use of research and impact evidence to support awareness, engagement and membership growth.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining how your skills and experience match the job description. In your letter, include a short answer to each question:

1. What interests you about u 3a and the Third Age Trust, and why does this role appeal to you at this point in your career?

2. Describe a recent campaign or project that showcased your skills. What made it a success and why?

3. This role will work closely with members and u 3as to find engaging stories. How do you build strong working relationships, and get people talking?

Shortlisted applicants notified by: Friday 4 December 2026.

Initial online interviews: Week commencing 7 December 2026.

This job description provides a general overview of the role and responsibilities and may be reviewed in line with organisational needs.

title: Content Coordinator
description:
This is a newly created, part-time contract role (three days a week), designed to bring structure, coordination and administrative discipline to ExchangeWire's content function. The Content Coordinator keeps the team running smoothly, looks after all content administration and keeps agreed processes on track. The right person is highly organised, proactive and comfortable working across teams and with part-time, remote staff.

Role Overview

The Content Coordinator works day to day with the Head of Content and closely with the COO, who is the point of escalation. The role covers the operational coordination of the content team:
- The editorial calendar and content schedule
- Workflow between content and other departments
- Content admin and tracking
- Client and contributor communications
- Coordination with the two part-time admin staff

Content operations & scheduling

Editorial calendar & scheduling
- Work with the Head of Content to maintain the editorial calendar, so that all content (sponsored and non-sponsored) is tracked from commission to publication.
- Keep track of the content pipeline and flag gaps, delays or conflicts to the Head of Content.
- Coordinate scheduling across written, audio and video formats to support a balanced, consistent output.
- Maintain tracking documents for all live content projects.

Process compliance
- Track whether agreed content production processes are being followed, including by freelancers, and flag any departures to the Head of Content.
- Act as the checkpoint between content creation and publication, so that no tasks or deliverables are overlooked.
- Identify process inefficiencies and raise them with the Head of Content or COO, along with proposed improvements.

Client & contributor communications

A key aspect of this role is ensuring that communication with clients and contributors is maintained and upheld.

Sponsored content comms
- On confirmation of a sponsored content deal, take ownership of initial outreach to the client: introduce the process, set expectations and confirm timelines.
- Manage ongoing communication with content clients throughout production, including chasing assets, providing updates and escalating blockers.
- Maintain a clear log of all active sponsored content projects and their status.

AV & multimedia comms (with the Multimedia Editor)
- Work closely with the Multimedia Editor so that guest and contributor communications for podcast and video content are handled in a timely and professional manner.
- Track guest confirmations, recording logistics and post-production communications for all AV formats.

Cross-functional coordination

Marketing interface

The Content Coordinator is the primary point of contact for marketing when they need content assets, scheduling support or publication assistance, and makes sure their requests are prioritised and actioned within agreed timelines. They also take part in the weekly cross-team meeting and maintain shared status updates.

Sales handover management

The Content Coordinator receives and tracks sponsored content handovers from the sales team, acknowledges receipt and communicates timelines to both the sales team and the client. They then monitor delivery against commitments and flag any at-risk projects early.

Team admin & coordination

The Content Coordinator works closely with ExchangeWire's two part-time admin staff, so that admin tasks are clearly allocated, understood and completed on time.

They coordinate regularly with both admin staff on priorities and deadlines, agree with the Head of Content how content-related admin tasks are allocated, and track those tasks through to completion. Any capacity issues or blockers are escalated to the Head of Content promptly.

General team admin

The Content Coordinator also maintains shared team documentation, keeps internal tracking tools up to date, and supports the Head of Content with client and internal reporting and performance data as required.

Skills & experience

Essential
- Demonstrable experience in an operations, coordination or project management role, ideally within media, publishing or B2 B.
- Exceptional organisational skills.
- Strong written communication skills.
- Confident working across teams and with senior stakeholders.
- Comfortable in a small business environment.
- Ability to be flexible, hands-on and autonomous.
- Able to work as an independent contractor (own limited company or sole trader) and invoice monthly.

Desirable
- Familiarity with the digital advertising or ad tech industry.
- Experience working with CMS platforms, project management tools and shared editorial calendars.
- Experience with client management.
- Previous experience working on a freelance or contract basis.

title: Content Manager
description:
Are you someone who loves creating content, spotting opportunities and finding new ways to bring stories to life? Do you have a natural curiosity, a creative mindset and the confidence to turn complex ideas into compelling content that captures people's attention?

We're looking for a talented Creative Content Manager to join a forward-thinking, internationally focused organisation operating within a fascinating and evolving global industry.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys being hands-on, takes real pride in their work and wants to play an important role in shaping how an organisation communicates with its audiences.

You'll be joining a team with a wealth of knowledge, expertise and interesting perspectives to share. Your role will be to bring that expertise to life through engaging, relevant and inspiring content across a variety of digital platforms.

The opportunity

This is much more than a content production role. We're looking for someone who can think creatively, spot a good story and take the initiative to make things happen.

You'll work closely with colleagues across marketing and the wider business to develop content that informs, inspires and engages. From turning research and specialist insights into accessible articles, to developing creative campaigns, social content and multimedia assets, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact on how the organisation connects with its audiences.

We want someone who is naturally curious, full of ideas and excited by the opportunity to experiment with different approaches, formats and channels.

What you'll be doing
- Developing, writing and editing engaging content across websites, blogs, email campaigns, social media, digital advertising and other communication channels.
- Working with subject matter experts and colleagues to uncover interesting insights, ideas and perspectives, transforming specialist information into accessible and compelling content.
- Creating and coordinating a variety of content, including video, photography, graphics, infographics, audio and other multimedia formats.
- Proactively identifying content opportunities, suggesting fresh ideas and looking for ways to make existing content more engaging, relevant and impactful.
- Managing content schedules, editorial calendars and projects to ensure ideas move from initial concept through to delivery and publication.
- Keeping up with digital trends, emerging platforms and creative formats, bringing new thinking to the team and helping test different ways of reaching audiences.
- Taking responsibility for content libraries and digital assets, ensuring materials are organised, accessible and used effectively.
- Working with internal stakeholders, external agencies, freelancers and creative suppliers to deliver high-quality content.
- Monitoring content performance, reviewing engagement and using insights to continually improve the quality and effectiveness of future activity.

The person we're looking for

Above all, we're looking for someone who genuinely loves content and has the drive and enthusiasm to make things happen.

You'll be creative, proactive and naturally curious. Someone who doesn't always wait to be told what to do, but actively looks for opportunities, brings suggestions to the table and takes ownership of delivering great work.

You'll ideally bring:
- Experience creating, writing, editing and publishing content across a range of digital channels.
- Excellent written communication skills and the ability to make complex or technical subjects interesting, clear and easy to understand.
- A creative eye and the ability to develop engaging content that stands out and connects with different audiences.
- Experience working with different content formats, including video, photography, graphics and social media.
- The confidence to generate ideas, challenge the status quo and suggest new ways of doing things.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines.
- Experience planning content, managing editorial calendars and coordinating creative projects.
- An understanding of digital engagement and how to use performance insights to make content more effective.
- The ability to build strong working relationships and collaborate with people across different teams and disciplines.

Most importantly, you'll bring energy, enthusiasm and a genuine interest in what the organisation does. You'll want to understand the business, its expertise and its audiences, and you'll be motivated to communicate its story in the best possible way.

title: CRM Executive
description:

Salary Banding: Up to £45,000 + Bonus

Be part of Something Big. Join the Wingstop Team!

At Wingstop, we are not just in the chicken business, we are in the flavour business. Our focus is on delivering exceptional experiences and memorable moments for both our customers and our team.

We have been recognised for our commitment to excellence earning accolades such as (Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2024, 2025 & 2026, The UK's Number 1 QSR Brand 2025 and Deliveroo's Number 1 Dish in 2025). But our mission remains simple: BRING THE FLAVOUR.

- Annual Bonus - 15% base with opportunity of stretch (based on personal performance and business performance
- LTIP Bonus - opportunity to join our Long-Term Investment Plan (Sign up after 3 years)

You'll be responsible for delivering engaging, personalised and insight-led customer communications across the full customer lifecycle, helping us attract new customers, drive repeat visits and build long-term brand loyalty.

- Develop strategies to increase Flavour Club sign-ups, active members, engagement and repeat visits.
- Identify opportunities to improve the customer experience and drive participation through targeted rewards, personalised offers and loyalty communications.
- Own the end-to-end delivery of campaigns and automated journeys across email, SMS and other customer touchpoints. From briefing and segmentation through to execution, testing and analysis.
- Work closely with the wider marketing team to ensure CRM & Loyalty activity supports brand campaigns, product launches and commercial objectives.
- Manage and maintain the Loyalty & CRM calendar, ensuring campaigns are delivered accurately and on time.
- Monitor and report on key CRM and loyalty KPIs, including member growth, active members, repeat purchase, customer frequency, retention, engagement and revenue.
- Use insights and performance data to continually improve effectiveness.
- Stay up to date with CRM, loyalty and personalisation trends, bringing new ideas and opportunities to the business.

What We're Looking For
- 3+ years' experience in a CRM or lifecycle marketing role, ideally within a fast-paced, retail, hospitality or QSR environment.
- Demonstrable experience managing or supporting a loyalty programme, with a good understanding of loyalty mechanics, customer retention and engagement strategies.
- Hands-on experience building and managing automated customer journeys and triggered campaigns.
- Strong analytical and data skills, with the ability to translate insights into actionable strategies.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong project management skills.
- Confident communicator who can work collaboratively with internal teams and external partners.
- A proactive, commercially minded approach, with the confidence to bring new ideas.

We're looking for someone who is naturally curious about customers, passionate about loyalty and excited by the opportunity to build meaningful customer relationships. You'll be organised, hands-on and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Most importantly, you'll want to be part of a growing brand and help make Wingstop's loyalty programme something our customers genuinely want to be part of.

Bring your authentic self to the process - that's who we're excited to meet.

25 day's holiday
Pension Plan
Career Progression

upport forecasting and business case development for future CRM initiatives.

title: Customer Marketing Executive
description:
Job Description

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. A big part of that is giving customers clear, timely communications that help them understand their options and feel confident about the decisions they make.

As a Marketing Executive in our Direct-to-Consumer Marketing team, you'll help bring that to life. From emails and customer journeys to campaigns such as Tax Year End and Refer a Friend, you'll help create communications customers can understand and trust, while developing your skills and learning how great customer marketing comes together in a regulated business.

What you'll do
- Help make investing easier to understand by supporting clear, relevant customer communications across email and other channels.
- Support campaigns such as Tax Year End and Refer a Friend, helping turn ideas into communications that reach customers at the right time.

What you'll bring
- At least one year's experience in customer marketing, with some knowledge of email marketing.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent proofreading skills.
- An understanding of what makes customer communications clear, accurate and engaging.
- Curiosity and creativity, with the confidence to ask questions and explore new ideas.
- A data-led mindset and an interest in testing, learning and improving.
- The ability to interpret data and customer insight and use it to inform your approach.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to work collaboratively with different teams.

About AJ Bell

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We're proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work for the past two years, building on six consecutive years as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For. It's recognition we're proud of and a reflection of the supportive and collaborative culture we strive to create for our people.

What we offer
- Salary £30,000 - £35,000 depending on experience
- 25 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays
- 6% Pension with matched contributions
- Discretionary bonus scheme
- Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)

- Free gym membership
- Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)
- Travel and bike loan schemes
- Employee Assistance Programme

Life at AJ Bell
- Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
- Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
- Casual dress code
- Friendly, supportive team environment

Our ways of working

We offer hybrid working, with a minimum of 50% of your working time per month spent in the office.

For new starters, there's an initial period of full-time office working to help you settle in and build relationships.

Inclusion & diversity

We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and able to be themselves at work.

- Line-manage the Senior FP&A Manager and the Operations Lead, setting priorities and supporting their development.
- Oversee forecasting and statutory matters, stepping in for detailed review and judgement rather than production.

- Develop the finance stack and processes, exploring how AI can deliver sharper commercial insight.
- Maintain continuity through the cover period and hand back cleanly.

- Qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA).

title: Global Brand Manager, Communications
company: The Body Shop International Limited - Company - Permanent
description:
The Body Shop

When Anita Roddick founded The Body Shop in 1976, she had a vision. Business as a force for good - that's us. 50 years later, we're proud to be pioneering cruelty-free beauty every step of the way. We're the original ethical beauty brand. We've got a thing for empowering people and enriching our planet. We're all about keeping it real, in every way possible. Our activist roots remain a huge part of everything we do, from our iconic window posters to our vegetarian products to our infamous campaigns. We're never afraid to stand up and speak the truth. We like to do things a little differently around here.

The Body Shop is committed to generating positive economic, social and environmental impact. We're fighting for what we believe in now more than ever. No holding back. Breaking the mould has always come naturally to us, and we need someone who's not afraid to mix things up.

Your role in a nutshell

Location: London (Hybrid) Reporting to: Global Head of Campaigns & Communications

At The Body Shop, we're on a mission to drive customer relevance, awareness, and loyalty through inspiring brand experiences that connect with consumers globally. We're looking for an experienced Senior Brand Marketing Manager to join our Global Marketing team on an 8-month fixed-term contract to lead the planning and delivery of high-impact global campaigns across multiple channels and markets.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic and commercially minded marketer who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment and is passionate about building iconic brands.

More about the role

As Senior Brand Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for developing and delivering global integrated marketing campaigns that strengthen The Body Shop's brand identity and drive business performance.

Working cross-functionally with teams across Creative, PR, Social Media, Retail Experience, Digital, Supply Chain and International Markets, you will lead campaigns from concept development through to activation and performance analysis.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the planning and delivery of global, multi-channel marketing campaigns from brief to execution.
- Develop clear and inspiring creative briefs that drive impactful consumer communications.
- Create integrated media and activation plans that support brand and commercial objectives.
- Analyse consumer, market and category trends to inform strategic planning and campaign development.
- Monitor campaign performance, identify key insights, and share learnings across the organisation.
- Partner with global and market teams to ensure seamless execution and localisation of campaigns.
- Drive consistency of brand positioning, visual identity and messaging across all touchpoints.
- Work closely with channel owners to optimise the customer experience and maximise campaign effectiveness.
- Manage relationships with external agencies and partners to deliver best-in-class work.
- Influence stakeholders across multiple functions to align teams behind campaign goals and priorities.

What we look for

Experience
- Experience in brand marketing and campaign management at a senior level.
- Proven experience developing and delivering large-scale marketing campaigns.
- Experience working within a global organisation.
- Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Retail, beauty, FMCG or consumer brand experience is advantageous.

Skills
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong project management and organisational abilities.
- Strategic thinker with a data-driven approach to decision making.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Commercially aware with a growth mindset.
- Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills.

Competencies
- Ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.
- Highly proactive with strong ownership and accountability.
- Creative problem-solver who can navigate ambiguity and drive change.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.
- Innovative thinker with strong critical thinking skills.

Why Join The Body Shop?

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in shaping global brand campaigns for one of the world's most recognised purpose-led beauty brands. You'll work with passionate teams across international markets and make a meaningful impact on how The Body Shop shows up for customers around the world.

Benefits

As well as a competitive salary, here are just a few of the rewards that you can look forward to if you join us: a 6% non-contributory pension plan, 23 days holiday, 50% staff discount and access to product sample sales, access to Perks at Work, our online shopping channel with exclusive deals & discounts, as well as LOVE money to spend on your wellbeing and personal development.

title: Growth Marketing & Demand Generation Manager
description:

- Manage campaign activity in HubSpot - building workflows, landing pages, email journeys, lead and nurture programmes and reporting dashboards
- Work alongside the Marketing Associate to plan and deliver campaigns, events and content, ensuring growth and demand generation priorities are planned and delivered
- Contribute to paid media planning (SEM and paid social) to ensure activity aligns with growth and demand generation priorities
- Contribute to marketing strategy and planning, including the annual timetable of events, and to company and product positioning and proposition work
- Contribute ideas and alignment on brand identity, sales and marketing collateral, thought leadership, press and PR, website content and SEO, events and webinars, and organic social, working closely with the wider marketing and creative teams
- Track, analyse and report on campaign and pipeline performance, making data-led recommendations to improve results
- Contribute to marketing budgeting and reporting
- Use and maintain proficiency across Sagacity's sales and marketing tooling, including HubSpot, LinkedIn, AMP (Jam 7), So Ampli, In Design and our AI-assisted design tools
- Maintain awareness of market and competitor activity, keeping up to date with sector trends and the competitive landscape

What we're looking for

Essential:
- At least 3 years' hands-on experience in growth marketing, demand generation or B2 B campaign management, gained within data services, technology, utilities or telecoms
- A proven track record of owning campaign planning and delivery end-to-end, with clear evidence of contribution to pipeline and revenue
- Experience running or contributing to account-based marketing (ABM) programmes
- Practical experience with HubSpot or an equivalent CRM / Sales / Marketing automation platforms, including workflows, landing pages and reporting
- A working understanding of paid media/SEM and how it supports demand generation activity
- Strong analytical skills, comfortable using data and campaign metrics to inform decisions and report on performance
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and confidence collaborating with Sales, Product and Commercial teams as well as the wider marketing team
- Highly organised, with strong planning and prioritisation skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines at once
- Commercially minded and passionate about how marketing activity translates into pipeline and revenue
- Have a keen eye for detail
- Have pride in your deliverables
- Good at working independently and as part of a team
- Are flexible, self-motivated and calm under pressure
- Have a commitment to personal development
- Have the right to work in the UK

Desirable:
- A marketing qualification - Degree or Professional Qualification (e.g. CIM)
- Experience with account-based marketing platforms or sales enablement/employee advocacy tools (e.g. So Ampli, Jam 7)
- Exposure to AI-assisted marketing or design tooling
- Experience working with external agencies
- Event or webinar planning experience

title: Growth Marketing Exec - Retail
description:
The Growth Marketing Executive - Retail supports the Senior Marketing Business Partner and Product Marketing Manager by coordinating and delivering demand-generation and lifecycle campaigns across the 9 brands in the Retail vertical - turning the vertical's plans into live, optimised, well-measured activity.

It's a hands-on, data-driven role at the heart of how the vertical gets work done: coordinating the campaign calendar, briefing and managing assets through the central engine, shepherding deliverables through review and approval, and turning performance data into clear reporting and recommendations the wider team can act on. You'll draw on ClearCourse's central marketing engine - a shared team, template library and AI-assisted production - to deliver at pace and scale.

Key Accountabilities:

Campaign Coordination & Delivery:
- Coordinate and deliver multi-channel acquisition and lifecycle campaigns (email, paid, web, social, organic) across the vertical's brands, against the plan set by the Senior Marketing Business Partner.
- Own the day-to-day running of the campaign calendar for your brands - keeping activity on schedule, dependencies tracked and stakeholders informed.
- Focus effort where the commercial opportunity is greatest, in line with the vertical's priorities and brand tiers.
- Create select marketing assets directly, without drawing on centralised resources, through our self-serve system, where images and copy can be created by the Product Marketing Team using pre-approved templates.

Briefing & Asset Management:
- Write clear, complete campaign and creative briefs using the agreed template, so work enters production right first time.
- Produce standard assets using the central template library and self-serve tools, and brief the central content, design and channel teams for anything non-standard.
- Manage assets through to delivery - tracking versions, keeping the brand's asset library and campaign records organised, and making sure the right, on-brand assets are used.

Deliverable Review & Approvals:
- Manage deliverables through the review process - checking work against the brief for quality, accuracy and brand consistency before it progresses.
- Obtain the necessary sign-offs (SMBP, and Product Director where required) and keep brief and approval status up to date, so nothing goes live unapproved.
- Keep delivery moving - chase inputs, unblock hold-ups and flag slippage early.

Data, Analytics & Reporting:
- Set up tracking and manage lead capture and routing, keeping data clean and reliable for accurate reporting.
- Prepare regular campaign and performance reports - clear, accurate and on time - for the SMBP and the wider vertical team.
- Turn the numbers into insight: spot what's working and what isn't, and proactively share findings and recommendations with the team.
- Make data-led suggestions for optimisation - budget, targeting, channel mix, messaging and creative - and help put the agreed changes into action.
- Support demand-generation programmes - nurture flows, lead scoring and campaign automation - and run A/B tests to improve ROAS and conversion.

Collaboration:
- Work closely with the central content, creative, martech and analytics functions, and support clean lead hand-off to sales / SDRs.

Requirements
- Experience delivering B2 B (or B2 B2 C) marketing campaigns across multiple channels - paid, organic, email or similar.
- Genuinely data-driven - confident pulling, reading and reporting on performance data, and turning it into clear insight and recommendations.
- Hands-on demand-generation, growth or digital marketing execution.
- Comfortable using AI - Claude in particular - as part of everyday work, applying it across most marketing workflows (drafting, research, analysis, reporting and campaign production) to work faster and better.
- Strong coordination and organisation - able to run a busy, multi-brand campaign calendar and keep briefs, assets and approvals on track.
- Clear briefing and communication skills, and an eye for quality and brand consistency when reviewing deliverables.
- Familiarity with paid platforms (Google / Meta / LinkedIn), email tools and GA4 (or similar analytics) is advantageous.
- Experience marketing SaaS or technology products is advantageous; retail software (EPOS, ecommerce, retail management) experience is a big plus, but not essential.
- Exposure to AI marketing tools is a plus.

Benefits

Because great work deserves great rewards. Here's what's in it for you:
- Competitive base salary

- Private medical cover
- Health cash plan
- Life assurance
- Access to the Calm wellbeing app

- Volunteering days
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Ongoing learning, development, and career progression across the ClearCourse Group

title: Marketing Content Specialist
description:
Marketing Content Specialist

Location: London - hybrid, home based 2 days per week

Salary: CHF 90 K plus excellent benefits package

About the Opportunity

Our client is an international B2 B software business seeking a hands-on Marketing Content Specialist to support marketing activity across EMEA, with a particular focus on telecoms and utilities.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who can turn technical information, customer insight and campaign briefs into clear, accurate and commercially effective content.

You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, Solution Engineering, Implementation and other regional and global stakeholders to deliver content and campaigns that support customer engagement, lead generation and pipeline growth.

Key Requirements

You will be a hands-on B2 B marketing professional with at least 3 years' experience, ideally gained within software, SaaS or another technical environment, together with relevant experience in telecoms and/or utilities. You will bring:
- Strong content creation and technical writing skills
- Ability to translate complex technical or engineering information into clear customer-facing content
- Experience creating customer stories, case studies, ebooks, presentations, proposal/RFP material, blogs, emails, landing pages and campaign assets
- Strong Microsoft Word and PowerPoint skills, including templates, tables and brand standards
- Experience building or supporting multi-channel B2 B marketing campaigns
- Experience using HubSpot and/or Salesforce
- Understanding of campaign tracking, lead generation, pipeline and marketing KPIs
- Experience working with technical, commercial and operational stakeholders
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
- Previous EMEA or multi-market European marketing experience would be a significant advantage.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
- Ability to take ownership, work independently, clarify briefs and keep stakeholders informed

Experience with Adobe InDesign would be highly valuable, while Canva and basic video editing would also be advantageous.

Role & Responsibilities

As a Marketing Content Specialist, you will turn technical expertise, customer insight and campaign strategy into effective marketing activity across EMEA. Your responsibilities will include:
- Creating and adapting content for telecoms and utilities audiences
- Working with Solution Engineers, Implementation teams and other subject matter experts to translate technical information into accessible content
- Developing customer stories and case studies through conversations with customers and internal technical teams
- Creating and formatting proposal, RFP and other customer-facing materials
- Producing blogs, emails, landing pages, presentations, ebooks, social content and other campaign assets
- Building and supporting multi-channel campaigns for defined customer segments
- Translating campaign objectives into clear execution plans and selecting appropriate content and channels
- Using HubSpot, Salesforce and related systems to support campaign activity and track leads, pipeline and performance
- Monitoring relevant KPIs and using results to improve future campaigns
- Supporting regional events and tradeshows
- Working closely with global Marketing, Sales, Product and technical teams
- Managing deadlines, flagging issues early and keeping stakeholders informed of progress

Why Join?

This is a strong opportunity to join an international software business operating in specialist telecoms and utilities markets, with the scope to take ownership and make a visible contribution to its EMEA growth.

You will work directly with technical experts, customers and international marketing colleagues, developing specialist industry knowledge while producing content and campaigns that have a direct impact on customer engagement and commercial performance.

title: Marketing coordinator
description:

Social Media & Content Creation
- Take full ownership of the company's social media accounts, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.
- Plan, create and publish engaging content across all platforms.
- Produce graphics, videos, reels, stories, job adverts and promotional content.
- Promote live vacancies, recruitment campaigns and company updates.
- Develop and manage a social media content calendar.

Previous experience working within a recruitment agency or recruitment marketing environment would be advantageous.

What We Offer
- 30,000 annual salary
- Fully remote working
- Head office based in Hounslow
- A varied and hands-on position with responsibility for the company's entire digital marketing presence.
- The opportunity to develop and shape the agency's marketing strategy and brand.

How to Apply

If you are a creative and motivated marketing professional with experience in social media, website management and digital marketing, we would love to hear from you.

We provide expert guidance to overcome the wide ranging cyber, information security and risk management challenges which impact business around the world.

ISF is looking for a proactive and ambitious Marketing Executive to join our marketing team in London. This role is ideal for someone with 1-2 years marketing experience who is keen to work closely with a sales team and see their marketing activity translate into real business outcomes.

Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for supporting campaign and cross-channel marketing activity, marketing technologies, and sales enablement with a strong focus on North America.

This is a dynamic role that offers plenty of variety and exposure to different areas of marketing. As part of a collaborative marketing team, you will work closely with colleagues across business units. You will need a keen eye to spot opportunities and help provide the intelligence, messaging, and materials that support ISF's go-to-market approach.

- Building, testing, launching and optimising cross-channel campaigns

- Confident, and comfortable putting forward a point of view to sales colleagues and senior stakeholders.

- Willing to take ownership and see projects through to the end.
- Organised and calm under pressure, able to run several pieces of work at once and meet deadlines.
- Curious, and quick to learn new tools or platforms.
- Happy in a small team where priorities move quickly and hands-on delivery matters.
- Open to feedback and keen to develop, with a clear interest in building a career in B2 B marketing.

Essential requirements and skills:
- Experience supporting regional or go-to-market campaigns and managing stakeholders.
- 1-2 years of marketing experience in a B2 B environment.
- Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms, such as Salesforce and Pardot.
- Good copywriting and proofreading skills, with excellent written and verbal English.
- Experience reporting on marketing performance using platform analytics, GA4 and a CRM.
- Competence with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
- A degree, a professional marketing qualification such as CIM, or equivalent practical experience.
- Ability to attend global events as required, and some event organising experience.

- Experience with account-based-marketing approaches and supporting a sales team.
- Experience working with North American audiences, or with colleagues in other time zones.
- Working knowledge of social media management in a business context, particularly LinkedIn.

description:

You'll take ownership of the partner education strategy, developing and delivering scalable, digital-first learning programmes across multiple channels and international markets.

Working closely with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing and other cross-functional teams, you'll create engaging learning journeys that support customer onboarding, improve product adoption and strengthen long-term partner relationships.

From webinars and interactive walkthroughs to automated learning campaigns, you'll build the frameworks and content strategies needed to deliver impactful education at scale.

- Lead digital education initiatives: Develop and deliver multi-format learning experiences, including live and on-demand webinars, interactive walkthroughs, self-guided tutorials and short-form educational content.

- Build scalable marketing frameworks: Develop repeatable processes, modular content strategies and efficient production models to deliver localised programmes across multiple countries.
- Measure commercial performance: Track the impact of education initiatives on customer activation, product adoption, retention, pipeline and revenue growth.
- Leverage data and innovation: Use analytics, customer feedback, automation and AI-powered tools to optimise campaign performance and improve content production efficiency.

What we're looking for:
- 7+ years of relevant experience in B2 B SaaS, fintech or multi-product technology environments, with a focus on marketing, customer education or partner adoption.
- Experience in Partner or Channel Marketing, Customer Education, Product Marketing or Growth Marketing.
- A proven ability to connect marketing and education initiatives to measurable business outcomes, including product adoption, retention and revenue growth.
- Strong customer and partner insight, with the ability to quickly understand technical product workflows and regulatory developments.
- Hands-on experience developing digital content and learning programmes across multiple platforms, managing external vendors and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
- Experience embedding educational content into automated lifecycle marketing, onboarding and wider go-to-market strategies.
- A track record of delivering localised marketing or education programmes across international markets, using automation and AI tools to improve scalability and efficiency.

If you have the relevant experience and are immediately available, please apply now with an up to date CV!
