Born on South Molton Street, London in 1971, Molton Brown is an icon of uniquely British style. Today, Molton Brown is one of the leading global brands in Kao's global cosmetics portfolio. Growing from small-scale artisans into the international fragrance brand it is today, its pioneering presence is felt in our stores and websites, travel retail, luxury department stores and the most esteemed hotels around the world.

Expertly blended in London, Molton Brown's signature fragrances, bath and shower gels, home and hand care luxuries have claimed iconic status. Kao and Molton Brown have a passion for integrity, for craftsmanship, for artistry and for giving our consumers the ultimate, quality experience.

About our role:

This role is a full time position on a 4-5 month fixed term contract.

Working closely with the Marketing Director, this role leads the development and execution of integrated 360 UKI marketing activations, bringing together Retail Engagement Marketing, PR/Influencer and Media plans, while partnering with Retail, CRM and Digital teams to drive profitable growth and strengthen brand desirability.

The role develops scalable launch and eventing strategies and brand partnerships, translating global brand strategy into impactful local execution while maintaining brand consistency. Through an integrated omnichannel approach, it delivers compelling consumer experiences, protects brand equity and drives commercial performance.

What you will do:
- Develop and lead integrated UK and Ireland marketing plans aligned to the global marketing calendar and business objectives. Translate global campaigns and new product launches into scalable activation strategies and plans working with the Marketing Director, global and local teams to ensure consistent brand execution and commercial impact.
- Lead PR/ influencer and media agency partners, developing integrated strategies and annual plans that build brand awareness, desirability and customer acquisition. Oversee campaign delivery across paid and earned channels, ensuring effective integration, clear performance measures and continuous optimisation.
- Provide strategic direction to the Brand Manager on UK and Ireland retail marketing plans. Oversee the development and execution of retail engagement initiatives across standalone stores and outlets, including in-store materials, communications, events and activations, ensuring consistent brand experiences that strengthen customer engagement and support commercial performance.
- Develop and lead the brand partnerships strategy, identifying and securing partnerships that strengthen brand desirability, increase awareness and drive customer acquisition. Lead partnership development and activation, ensuring alignment with brand positioning, marketing priorities and commercial objectives, and evaluate performance to inform future opportunities.
- Manage marketing budgets, investment allocation and performance reporting, ensuring effective governance and value from marketing spend. Lead, develop and inspire direct reports, setting clear objectives, supporting professional development and conducting regular performance reviews. Oversee global activation tools and programmes to drive consistency, efficiency and effective implementation across markets.

What you will need:
- Degree educated or equivalent
- 7+ years relevant marketing experience, ideally within the beauty, fragrance or luxury consumer sector.
- Experience developing and delivering integrated, multi-channel brand marketing strategies and campaign activations.
- Experience working within a global brand or multi-market business, translating global strategies into effective local execution.
- Proven experience managing agency partners across media, public relations, influencer marketing and experiential activations.
- Experience developing retail engagement plans and brand partnerships that drive consumer engagement, brand desirability and commercial performance.
- Strong project management skills, with experience managing budgets, multiple stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
- Management experience
- Strategy development, long term as well as tactical thinking. Demonstrable business and consumer focus and ability to turn insight into actionable projects
- Excellent analytical, communication and presentation skills. Highly organised with strong attention to detail
- Proactive with a high level of initiative and a clear focus on delivering tangible results.
- A team player, collaborative in nature.
- Consumer obsessed. Passionate about product, brand and retailing
- Strong project management skills.

Molton Brown is part of Kao founded in Japan in 1887, at Kao, we believe the diversity of our teams strengthens our global mission. Here we trust and respect each other, collaborating in a friendly and inclusive work environment to achieve great results.

What you can expect from us:
- An entrepreneurial environment where passionate and innovative teams come together.
- Respect, teamwork and collaboration are at the heart of how we work.
- A workplace culture that prioritises employee wellbeing, with opportunities to get involved in initiatives such as Mental Health First Aiders, the Charity Committee, and DE&I communities (region dependant)
- A broad range of benefits, including flexible working, competitive salaries, health and wellbeing offers, pension / retirement options dependant on location, insurance options, and more
- Learning and development opportunities

Your voice matters here - we value entrepreneurial thinking and innovation from our teams. To find out why 33,000 people across the Globe work at Kao please visit:

Discover careers at Kao and how we live our purpose, Kirei - Making Life Beautiful.

title: Senior Account Manager - Experiential & Brand Activation
description:
Senior Account Manager - Experiential, Sampling & Brand Activation

Location: London

Salary: Up to £45,000 DOE

Sector: Experiential / Sampling / Brand Activation / FMCG

We're working with a fantastic independent integrated marketing agency that's looking for an experienced Senior Account Manager to join its growing activation team.

This is a brilliant opportunity to work with some of the UK's best-known food and drink brands, delivering exciting experiential campaigns, large-scale sampling programmes, retail activations and integrated marketing campaigns.

The agency is expanding its in-house experiential and sampling offering, so you'll play an important role in helping develop this area of the business while managing key client relationships and delivering outstanding campaigns.

The Role
- Manage experiential and brand activation campaigns from initial brief through to live delivery.
- Help develop the agency's growing in-house sampling and experiential offering.
- Plan and deliver sampling programmes across retail, events and street activations.
- Coordinate campaign logistics, staffing, stock management, permits and health & safety requirements.
- Oversee in-store activations, pop-ups, roadshows and multi-site retail roll-outs.
- Manage POS production, retail materials and campaign implementation.
- Work closely with PR, creative, digital and media teams to deliver integrated B2 B and B2 C campaigns.
- Build strong relationships with clients across food and drink and FMCG.
- Manage campaign budgets, timelines, suppliers and profitability.
- Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts and support new business activity.

About You
- 6+ years' experience in agency-side account management or client services.
- Strong background in experiential marketing, sampling, shopper marketing or brand activation.
- Proven experience delivering campaigns from concept through to live activation.
- Hands-on understanding of sampling operations, staffing, logistics and event delivery.
- Experience managing retail activations, POS production or multi-site roll-outs.
- Excellent client relationship management and communication skills.
- Strong commercial awareness and experience managing budgets.
- Comfortable working across integrated B2 B and B2 C campaigns.
- Food and drink / FMCG experience would be a big advantage.
- Proactive, organised and collaborative, with a genuine enthusiasm for experiential marketing.

What's on Offer?
- Salary up to £45,000 depending on experience.
- The opportunity to work on exciting campaigns for leading food and drink brands.
- A varied mix of experiential, sampling, shopper and integrated marketing projects.
- The chance to help develop a growing in-house activation offering.
- A creative, collaborative and established independent agency environment.
- Genuine opportunities for career progression.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Senior Account Manager with a passion for experiential marketing, sampling and bringing brands to life, we'd love to hear from you.

If this sounds like you, please get in touch quoting AP1202.

title: Senior Analyst- Performance Marketing
company: Harnham - Data & Analytics Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
This is an opportunity to join a organisation investing heavily in marketing effectiveness and customer analytics. Sitting within a commercial analytics function, you'll play a key role in helping marketing teams understand performance, optimise media investment, and work with MMM models.The CompanyThe organisation is undergoing significant transformation across data, analytics, and marketing. Analytics plays a central role in commercial decision-making, with teams working closely with stakeholders to improve customer acquisition, engagement, and long-term value.The business is continuing to expand its analytical capabilities and is investing in modern data platforms, marketing measurement, and advanced modelling to support smarter marketing decisions.The RoleAs a Senior Analyst, Performance Marketing, you will partner closely with marketing stakeholders to deliver insights that improve paid media effectiveness and maximise return on investment.Key responsibilities include:
- Building and maintaining analytical solutions to measure paid media performance across channels and campaigns
- Using SQL to create scalable datasets and automate reporting processes
- Delivering deep-dive analysis into customer acquisition, conversion, retention, and campaign effectiveness
- Developing dashboards and reporting solutions to support marketing decision-making

- Assessing attribution models and identifying opportunities to improve marketing measurement
- Translating complex analytical findings into clear commercial recommendations
- Collaborating with data engineering and technology teams to ensure data quality and reliable reporting

Your Skills & Experience
- Strong commercial experience using SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis
- Experience working within performance marketing, digital marketing analytics, or paid media analytics
- Understanding of paid media measurement, ROI, ROAS, attribution, and marketing effectiveness
- Experience building dashboards and analytical products using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker
- Exposure to Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), including supporting model inputs, interpreting outputs, or working alongside modelling teams
- Experience using Python or R for analysis and automation is beneficial
- Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate analytical insights to non-technical audiences
- Experience working with large-scale customer, campaign, or marketing datasets

title: Senior Brand Copywriter and Tone of Voice Lead
description:
Senior Brand Copywriter & Tone of Voice Lead

UK-wide Full-time 35 hours per week

An opportunity for an exceptional brand copywriter to shape the voice of a leading international professional services firm.

The role will lead the creation and rollout of a distinctive brand voice, turning brand strategy into compelling, confident and memorable copy across digital, campaigns, client communications, recruitment and early careers.

This is a hands-on creative role for someone who can develop big ideas, find the right words and make complex messages simple, engaging and commercially relevant.

The role
- Create original, high-impact brand and campaign copy across web, advertising, social, film, email, recruitment and marketing channels.
- Help define and embed a distinctive tone of voice, developing practical principles, examples and guidance.
- Turn complex business and professional services messages into clear, human and compelling communications.
- Develop headlines, propositions, straplines, messaging frameworks and creative concepts.
- Build reusable copy, templates and tools to help colleagues communicate consistently across international markets.
- Work closely with senior stakeholders, creative partners and content teams to bring the brand to life.
- Deliver workshops, coaching and practical guidance to build writing capability across the business.
- Explore AI-assisted workflows while protecting quality, accuracy and brand distinctiveness.

The person

The successful candidate will be an experienced senior brand or creative copywriter, with a strong portfolio of original brand, campaign and tone-of-voice work.

They will bring:
- Experience leading copy development for a major brand launch, rebrand or tone-of-voice transformation.
- A flair for memorable language, strong creative concepts and distinctive verbal identities.
- The ability to translate brand strategy into concise, audience-led copy across multiple channels.
- Experience simplifying complex subject matter without losing accuracy or credibility.
- Confidence influencing senior stakeholders and challenging generic, jargon-heavy writing.
- Experience developing practical brand guidelines, messaging frameworks and coaching materials.
- The ability to manage multiple briefs and deadlines in a fast-paced, international environment.
- An interest in using AI creatively and responsibly.

Professional services or legal sector experience would be advantageous, but is not essential.

The opportunity

A chance to make a tangible impact on a major brand transformation, shape how an international organisation communicates and leave behind a distinctive, practical and lasting verbal identity.

How to apply

Applicants should submit a portfolio showcasing three examples of original brand, campaign or tone-of-voice work.

The selection process will include a timed creative copywriting exercise, developing a messaging concept and adapting it across several formats.

If this job isn't quite right for you, but you know someone who would be great at this role, why not take advantage of our referral scheme? We offer £200 in shopping vouchers for every referred candidate who we place in a role. Terms & Conditions Apply.

title: Senior Creator Executive - Social Media Campaigns. Social Agency
description:
Creator Marketing Social Media Client Management Creative Agency

We're TSA (The Stile Agency), a rapidly growing, creator-inspired social media agency working with some fantastic brands, including De'Longhi, E.ON Next and Jack Daniel's.

We've grown by over 70% in the last 12 months, combining the energy and creativity of a fast-moving agency with the backing of global independent creative agency Five by Five.

We're looking for a talented Senior (Influencer) Creator Executive who knows how to bring creator campaigns to life from sourcing and managing talent to coordinating deliverables, building client relationships and measuring results.

This is about managing creators and campaigns, not being the content creator yourself.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone who enjoys the full creator marketing journey, from discovering the perfect talent and building relationships to managing client expectations, delivering campaigns and measuring results.

The Role at a Glance

Senior (Influencer) Creator Executive
Central London Hybrid (In office Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday)
£35,000 DOE
Full Time Permanent

Creator Marketing: Social Media Campaigns Creator Outreach Talent Relationships Gifting Events

Client Delivery: Campaign Management Client Relationships KPIs Reporting Creative Ideas

Bring Creator Campaigns to Life.

You'll take ownership of multiple creator campaigns, working closely with clients, creators and the wider TSA team to deliver exciting, effective work.

From the initial brief through to creator selection, outreach, gifting, content delivery and reporting, you'll make sure campaigns run smoothly, stay on budget and achieve great results.

You'll also be a trusted contact for clients, proactively spotting opportunities, bringing fresh ideas to the table and helping grow our creator network.

Where You'll Make an Impact
- Managing multiple creator campaigns from brief to delivery
- Researching, identifying and approaching creators who are the right fit for each brand
- Building strong relationships with creators and nurturing TSA's growing network
- Owning day-to-day client communications, updates and campaign coordination
- Managing creator gifting campaigns and ensuring a seamless experience
- Coordinating creator events, from invitations and planning through to hosting
- Keeping campaigns on schedule, within budget and focused on client KPIs
- Developing fresh campaign ideas, creative opportunities and ways to grow client accounts
- Monitoring creator performance and producing clear, tailored client reports
- Anticipating challenges, solving problems and keeping projects moving

About You

You're passionate about creator culture, social media and the brands shaping what's next.

You've already gained solid experience delivering creator or influencer campaigns and are ready for a role with more ownership, responsibility and client exposure.

You're organised, creative, commercially aware and confident managing multiple moving parts without losing sight of the details.

You'll ideally bring:
- 2+ years' experience in creator marketing, social media marketing or a closely related role
- Hands-on experience managing creator campaigns from brief to delivery
- Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other social platforms
- Experience researching, selecting and building relationships with creators
- Confidence managing client communications and expectations
- Excellent organisation and the ability to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines
- Strong written communication, copywriting and presentation skills
- Experience monitoring campaign performance and reporting against KPIs
- Confidence using Excel, PowerPoint and everyday marketing tools
- A proactive, collaborative approach and plenty of creative ideas

Experience with Google Analytics would be a bonus.

Above all, you'll bring positive energy, initiative and a genuine enthusiasm for the creator marketing industry.

Why TSA?

Founded in 2020, TSA has quickly established itself as an exciting name in creator-led social media marketing.

We're growing fast, working with brilliant brands and building an agency where creativity, collaboration and fresh thinking are encouraged.

You'll have the opportunity to take real ownership of campaigns, develop strong client and creator relationships and grow your career alongside an ambitious team.

What We Offer
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Bupa private healthcare and health cash plan
- Pension scheme with increasing employer contributions
- Work from anywhere allowance
- Enhanced parental leave, subject to eligibility
- Life and personal accident insurance
- Discounted shopping and gym memberships
- Interest-free commuting and life loans
- Free fruit and office bar

Your Experience / Background / Previous Roles May Include
Senior Creator Executive, Creator Marketing Executive, Influencer Marketing Executive, Senior Influencer Executive, Influencer Account Executive, Creator Partnerships Executive, Talent Partnerships Executive, Social Media Account Executive, Influencer Campaign Executive, Creator Campaign Manager.

Ready to Make Your Mark in Creator Marketing?

If you love the creator space, know how to deliver standout campaigns and want to be part of an agency that's going places, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and help shape what's next at TSA.

Application notice We take your privacy seriously. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

Using keyword, search intent and performance insights to inform content creation and optimisation

Managing content through the full CMS publishing lifecycle, from brief and draft through to review, publishing and iteration

Supporting the editorial calendar and coordinating content delivery with relevant stakeholders

Working with insights and analytics teams to identify priorities and measure the impact of content initiatives

Helping improve organic visibility, SERP coverage, engagement and AI search visibility

Championing SEO and emerging GEO best practice across the wider content team

Ensuring content reflects brand tone, audience needs and relevant cultural or regional nuances

You - Skills & Experience:

Strong experience in SEO content, editorial production and web copywriting, ideally within a major brand or media environment

3+ years' experience implementing SEO content tactics, including on-page optimisation, keyword research, content gaps and search intent

Proven ability to create and optimise content that has improved organic rankings, traffic, visibility or engagement

Strong editorial and copywriting skills, with the ability to produce clear, helpful and engaging content

Hands-on experience working within a CMS and managing content from creation through to publication and optimisation

Good understanding of how content is evolving within AI search, LLMs and answer engines

Experience with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Moz, Google Analytics or similar

title: SEO Lead
description:
Reed Online is looking for an SEO Lead to join their team in Holborn, London.

Overview

Reed Online is one of the UK's leading job sites, appearing in over 1 billion job searches annually and connecting millions of candidates with employers across the country. We're looking for an experienced SEO Lead to take ownership of our day-to-day SEO performance and help drive sustainable organic growth across Reed Online.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who will be an SEO champion within the business. You'll proactively monitor our organic performance, identify opportunities and risks, and turn SEO insight into clear recommendations and priorities. Working closely with our external SEO consultant and Digital PR agency, you'll collaborate across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Content and Marketing to ensure SEO is considered in relevant decisions and opportunities are successfully delivered.

Traditional search will remain at the heart of the role. You'll also help us understand and respond to the evolving landscape of AI-powered search and LLM visibility, ensuring Reed Online is well positioned as candidate search behaviours develop.

Key Responsibilities
- Champion SEO across Reed Online, ensuring organic search is understood and considered in relevant product, content and technology decisions.
- Proactively monitor and analyse organic search performance, identifying changes, risks and growth opportunities and translating these into clear recommendations and priorities.
- Own the day-to-day SEO operation, setting clear briefs and priorities, challenging recommendations where appropriate and holding teams accountable for high-quality delivery and results.
- Work closely with our SEO consultant to help translate SEO strategy into a clear, actionable roadmap and identify opportunities to improve performance.
- Partner with Product, Engineering and Delivery teams to embed SEO best practice, provide input into new products and site changes, and ensure SEO requirements are understood and successfully implemented.
- Identify and diagnose technical SEO opportunities and issues across areas including crawling, indexing, site architecture, internal linking and structured data, working with Engineering on implementation.
- Work collaboratively with Content and Marketing teams on keyword research, search demand, content optimisation, competitor analysis and opportunities to strengthen organic visibility.
- Monitor search engine developments, competitor activity and emerging AI search and LLM discovery trends, identifying opportunities to test, learn and evolve our approach.

Skills & Experience
- 4-5+ years of SEO experience, with a strong background on technical and on-page SEO and knowledge of Digital PR and how it complements SEO efforts.
- A proven track record of using SEO insight and recommendations to improve organic performance on medium to large sites, e-commerce or platforms with short lived content.
- Good technical SEO knowledge, including crawling and indexing, site architecture, internal linking, structured data and rendering JavaScript / dynamic content with the ability to work effectively with Engineering teams on implementation.
- Strong analytical skills and experience using platforms such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics and enterprise SEO and crawling tools to understand performance, test and discover issues.
- Experience managing SEO agencies or specialist partners, with the confidence to set priorities, challenge recommendations and drive high-quality delivery.
- Excellent communication, collaboration and project management skills, with experience influencing Product, Engineering and other non-SEO stakeholders and translating SEO requirements into clear business recommendations.
- A proactive and commercially minded approach, with the curiosity to investigate performance changes, identify opportunities and prioritise activity according to likely business impact.
- A good foundational understanding of AI-powered search, LLMs and emerging approaches to search visibility, alongside a genuine curiosity to develop your knowledge as the landscape evolves.

Additional Requirements
- Must be located in and eligible to work in the UK
- Must have a 2:1 degree or equivalent (e.g. apprenticeship)

title: Marketing Coordinator - Join an Award-Winning Tech Innovator
description:
Marketing Campaigns Events Copywriting Digital Marketing Marketing Operations

Some marketing roles are all about ideas. Others are all about organisation.

This one brings the two together.

Welcome to Tollring, an award-winning UK technology business helping organisations turn business communications into powerful insights through intelligent analytics, AI-powered solutions and innovative software.

We're growing, investing in exciting new products and expanding our marketing activity. Now we're looking for a bright, proactive Marketing Coordinator to help bring our campaigns, events and communications to life.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone with a couple of years' marketing experience who loves variety, takes pride in the details and wants to develop into a well-rounded marketing professional.

The Role at a Glance

Marketing Coordinator
Uxbridge, West London Hybrid (Typically 1 day per week in the office -Thursdays- with flexibility for additional attendance when required)
£31,000 £36,000 DOE
Full Time Permanent 37.5 hours per week
Monday Friday, 9am 5:30pm

Your Background / Skills: Marketing Coordination, Campaign Support, Event Management, Copywriting, Email Marketing, Digital Marketing, CMS, WordPress, Marketing Administration, Budget Tracking, Excel, Reporting.

The Tollring Story

At Tollring, we're passionate about helping businesses make smarter decisions through technology.

Our award-winning software helps organisations understand customer conversations, improve performance and unlock valuable insights from their communications.

With innovative solutions spanning call analytics, conversation intelligence, call recording and fraud protection, we're a growing technology business with ambitious plans and exciting new product launches ahead.

But what makes Tollring special is our people.

We're a collaborative team where ideas are welcomed, colleagues support one another and everyone has the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution.

Your Role in the Story

Working closely with our Marketing Communications Manager, Digital Marketer and Graphic Designer, you'll help keep a busy, varied marketing function running brilliantly.

One day you might be coordinating an industry event, the next preparing an email campaign, updating website content or pulling together performance reports for senior leadership.

You'll have plenty of guidance and support, but also the freedom to take ownership, solve problems and make things happen.

Where You'll Make an Impact
- Campaigns & Content: Support marketing campaigns, write engaging first drafts for emails and landing pages, and help deliver social and digital marketing activity.
- Website & Digital: Upload and edit website content using CMS platforms, supporting SEO and maintaining brand standards.
- Events & Webinars: Coordinate industry events, exhibitions and webinars, managing suppliers, logistics, materials, deadlines and follow-up reporting.
- Marketing Performance: Compile monthly marketing reports, track campaign activity and help turn results into useful insights.
- Budgets & Administration: Manage marketing spend records, invoices and budget tracking, working closely with the accounts team.
- Internal Communications: Help produce newsletters, coordinate internal events and keep colleagues informed and engaged.
- Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with Sales, Customer Success and senior leadership to support marketing initiatives and partner activities.
- Keeping Things Moving: Stay on top of priorities, anticipate challenges and make sure the little details never become big problems.

About You

You're a marketer at heart, but you're also someone who loves getting things organised and seeing a project through.

You enjoy writing, communicating and contributing creative ideas, while understanding that great marketing also depends on deadlines, budgets, accurate reporting and reliable execution.

You're confident working independently, happy to ask questions and willing to get stuck into whatever needs doing.

You'll bring:
- Around 2 years' experience in a marketing coordination, marketing executive or similar role, ideally within a busy, varied environment.
- Practical experience coordinating events, campaigns or marketing projects with competing deadlines.
- Strong written English, with the ability to draft clear, engaging marketing copy and proofread accurately.
- Excellent organisation, attention to detail and the ability to take ownership of responsibilities.
- Confident everyday IT skills, particularly Microsoft Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
- Experience liaising with suppliers, coordinating marketing materials or managing event logistics.
- A basic understanding of marketing principles and how campaigns engage different audiences.
- A proactive, adaptable approach and the confidence to work across different teams and priorities.

Even better if you have:
- Experience in B2 B technology, SaaS, software or telecoms.
- Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, Zoho CRM, Buffer or Mailchimp.
- Experience tracking marketing budgets, campaign performance or event-generated leads.
- Experience updating website content using a CMS.
- An interest in using AI and emerging tools to improve marketing effectiveness.

You don't need to be an expert in every marketing discipline. What matters is that you've already developed a solid professional foundation, can manage your own workload and are genuinely excited to keep learning.

Why Join Tollring?

Because this isn't a role where you'll spend your career doing the same thing every day.

You'll gain exposure to campaigns, events, digital marketing, content, reporting and the commercial side of marketing, all while working alongside experienced colleagues who are happy to share their knowledge.

As Tollring continues to grow, there's real scope to develop your skills, take on more campaign responsibility and shape your future in marketing.

You'll also enjoy:
- A salary of £31,000 £36,000 DOE.
- Hybrid working with a supportive, collaborative team.
- Exposure to exciting technology, product launches and B2 B marketing.
- A varied role with genuine ownership and visibility across the business.
- Opportunities for training, learning and professional development.
- The chance to make a real impact within a growing, established technology company.

Ready to Make Things Happen?

If you're an organised, enthusiastic marketer who enjoys variety, loves getting the details right and wants to build a brilliant career in B2 B marketing, we'd love to hear from you.

Ecommerce Concessions Assistant
